regex.syntax: tokens separated by spaces; | union, * + ? {n,m} repetition, ( ) grouping, () empty string
regex.cycleCutMeaning: complete interactions with the cycles cut: going down the hierarchy and back up (zoom out, back, background); shortcuts (jumps to a state of another branch) are not expanded in the regex and are listed in regex.cycles.shortcutTransitions

cycles.meaning: spanning tree from the initial state (by hierarchical name when there is one, otherwise by BFS): tree = from parent to child, back = to an ancestor (closes a cycle), shortcut = to another branch

regex.languageMeaning: standard semantics: matches EXACTLY the sequences of interactions (clicks and hovers) that can be performed from the initial state (without the ones that break the page)
regex.completeInteractionsMeaning: sequences that return to the initial state; every performable sequence is a prefix of one of these

hovers.meaning: hover actions (the pointer enters an element) that change something visible. transient: a highlight or tooltip that disappears on leaving and does not change what can be done (a loop on its state); structural: opens something or leaves a change, leading to another state (its way back is Unhover_); error: doing it breaks the page (reported as unexpected behavior). changes is the observed effect; hovers with no visible effect are not actions (ignored). positional: the effect depends on where the pointer is aimed; it was tested at the center and at the edge of the element
